lines: At three A M, my phone buzzed.
I live alone. And I was standing in the kitchen.
I opened the app. My bed was empty. But on the edge of the mattress, something was sitting. Perfectly still. Facing the wall.
Then it turned its head. Slowly. Until it was looking straight into the camera.
My phone buzzed again. Motion detected. Stairs.
One more alert. Motion detected. Kitchen.
